title: A Tide for the Songbook
author: Quentin Winterbourne
blurb: Tamsin Brightwater, a wedding planner who doesn't believe in weddings anymore, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. But when a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
